anomalies.observed: The net name NET0005 appears on the battery path (Q3 output and the BAT bus pins of J5/J8) and also on the MAX3485 DE control pin (U2 pin 3), with R14 tied to the same node. This merges the /BAT power net with the MAX3485 direction-enable/control node.
anomalies.expected: The battery/BAT net should be isolated to the battery connector, Q3, and the M5Stack BAT bus pins. The MAX3485 DE/RE enable node should be a separate low-voltage control net driven by the BC857 direction-control transistor and pulled by the 20 k enable resistor, not connected to the battery rail.

evidence.quote: J5/J8 show NET0005 on the BAT bus pin; Q3 output is labeled NET0005; U2 pin 3 (DE) is also labeled NET0005, with R14 on that node.
Q1 | IRLML6402 (P-ch MOSFET) | High-side battery disconnect switch: gates the battery connector (J5) onto the /BAT bus net.
Q2 | BC857 (PNP) | Auto TX/RX direction-control transistor: driven from /TXD2 ... to toggle the MAX3485 DE/RE enable pins.

anomalies.impact: The battery rail is shorted to the MAX3485 DE/RE control node and to ground through the 20 k resistor. This can overvoltage the 3.3 V-powered MAX3485, permanently enable the driver, load/discharge the battery, and likely damage the transceiver or direction-control transistor.

anomalies.observed: The high-side battery MOSFET is shown as a 2N7002 N-channel device in the battery switch position.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires an IRLML6402 P-channel MOSFET for the high-side battery disconnect switch, with the gate pulled low through the switch/pull-up network to turn the battery path on.

evidence.quote: Battery MOSFET near J9 is labeled 2N7002.
Q1 | IRLML6402 (P-ch MOSFET) | High-side battery disconnect switch ... SW1 ... pulls Q1's gate low ... to turn the battery path on.

anomalies.impact: An N-channel MOSFET cannot be driven correctly as this high-side switch; the optional battery disconnect path would be inverted or fail to connect the battery as intended.

parsed.summary: The drawing contains at least one clear connectivity anomaly: the battery/BAT net and the MAX3485 DE/RE enable node are merged under NET0005, tying a power rail to a transceiver control pin. The battery MOSFET also appears to be the wrong channel type relative to the specified high-side P-channel switch.
